lessons.cat: Turn your phone on and off
lessons.title: Find the side buttons
lessons.desc: Learn where the Volume up, Volume down and Side buttons are on a Galaxy phone, and what each one does.
steps: Look at the right edge of your phone.
There are three buttons. From the top: Volume up, Volume down and the Side button.
Press the Side button in the picture.
It is the bottom button. Use it to turn the phone on and off or to turn off the screen.
Press the Volume down button in the picture.
It is the middle button. It makes the sound quieter.
Press the Volume up button in the picture.
It is the top button. It makes the sound louder.

lessons.cat: Turn your phone on and off
lessons.title: Charge your phone
lessons.desc: Charge your Galaxy phone step by step: plug in the charger, connect the cable and check the charging sign.
steps: Plug the charger into a wall outlet.
Plug the end of the cable into the port at the bottom of your phone.
If the port is wet, let it dry completely first.
Check that a charging sign appears on the screen.
Unplug the cable when charging is finished.
ko: 선 끝을 휴대폰 아래쪽 구멍에 꽂으세요.

lessons.cat: Turn your phone on and off
lessons.title: Turn your phone off and on again
lessons.desc: Turn a Galaxy phone off with the Side and Volume down buttons, then turn it back on.
steps: Press and hold the Side button and the Volume down button together.
Press both at the same time and wait for the menu to appear.
Tap Power off.
Tap Power off once more.
When the screen goes dark, go to the next step to turn it on again.
Press and hold the Side button to turn the phone on.
Hold it for a few seconds until the Samsung logo appears. Then unlock the screen.
ko: 옆면 버튼과 음량 줄이기 버튼을 함께 길게 누르세요.
전원 끄기를 한 번 더 누르세요.
옆면 버튼을 길게 눌러 전원을 켜세요.

lessons.cat: Turn your phone on and off
lessons.title: Restart your phone
lessons.desc: Restart a Galaxy phone when it is slow or acting strangely.
steps: Press and hold the Side button and the Volume down button together.
Hold them until the power menu appears.
Tap Restart.
Tap Restart once more.
Wait for the phone to turn off and on again.
If the screen is frozen and no menu appears, hold both buttons for more than 7 seconds.
ko: 옆면 버튼과 음량 줄이기 버튼을 함께 길게 누르세요.
다시 시작을 한 번 더 누르세요.

lessons.cat: Turn your phone on and off
lessons.title: Lock and unlock the screen
lessons.desc: Lock the screen with the Side button and unlock it again by swiping up.
steps: Press the Side button once, briefly.
The screen turns off and locks automatically.
Press the Side button briefly again.
The lock screen turns on. You can also double-tap the screen.
Swipe up on the screen.
If you set a PIN or fingerprint, use it to unlock.
ko: 측면 버튼을 한 번 짧게 누르세요.

lessons.title: Tap once
lessons.desc: Practice the most basic touch: tapping once to open an app.
steps: Tap Gallery lightly once with your fingertip.
Do not press hard. A light tap opens the app.
Tap the Home button at the bottom center.
You go back to the first screen (the Home screen).
ko: 갤러리를 손끝으로 가볍게 한 번 누르세요.

lessons.title: Touch and hold
lessons.desc: Practice touch and hold to open the menu for an app.
steps: Touch and hold Gallery for 2 seconds.
Keep your finger down until a menu appears.
Check that a menu appeared.
Touch and hold shows what you can do with that app.
Tap the Back button to close the menu.

lessons.title: Swipe to move around
lessons.desc: Swipe to move between Home screen pages and to open the Apps screen.
steps: Swipe left on the screen.
You move to the next page of the Home screen.
Swipe up from the bottom of the Home screen.
The Apps screen with all your apps opens.
Swipe down on the Apps screen.
You go back to the Home screen.

lessons.title: Zoom with two fingers
lessons.desc: Spread two fingers to zoom in on a photo and pinch them together to zoom out.
steps: Tap the ‘Gallery’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the photo you want to see.
Put two fingers on the photo and spread them apart.
Spread your thumb and index finger to make it bigger.
Pinch your two fingers together.
The photo gets smaller again.
ko: 두 손가락을 사진 위에 대고 벌리세요.

lessons.title: Go back
lessons.desc: Use the Back button to return to the previous screen.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Display’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap the Back button at the bottom right.
You go back to the previous screen (Settings).
You can change the button order in Settings → Display → Navigation bar.

lessons.title: Go to the Home screen
lessons.desc: Go back to the Home screen from any app with the Home button.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the Home button at the bottom center.
You go back to the first screen (the Home screen).
Check that the Home screen appeared.
Whatever app you are using, the Home button brings you here.
If you cannot see the buttons, swipe up a little from the very bottom of the screen.

lessons.title: Open recent apps
lessons.desc: Open recent apps to switch between apps or close them all.
steps: Tap the Recents button at the bottom left.
Apps you used recently appear like cards.
Tap the app you want to use again.
Swipe sideways to see other apps.
Tap the Recents button again.
Tap ‘Close all’.
All open apps are closed.
ko: 아래쪽 왼쪽 최근 앱 버튼을 누르세요.

lessons.title: Make text bigger
lessons.desc: Make text bigger and bold on a Galaxy phone in Settings → Display → Font size and style.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Display’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Font size and style’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Drag the circle on the font size bar to the right.
The further right, the bigger the text.
Tap the ‘Bold font’ switch to turn it on.
Bold text is easier to read.
Check that the text got bigger.
ko: 글자 크기 막대의 동그라미를 오른쪽으로 미세요.

lessons.title: Make the screen and icons bigger
lessons.desc: Make icons and buttons bigger with Screen zoom in Settings → Display.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Display’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Screen zoom’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Drag the circle on the bar to the right.
The further right, the bigger the icons and buttons.
Check that the icons and buttons got bigger.

lessons.title: Turn on Easy mode
lessons.desc: Turn on Easy mode for a simpler Home screen with bigger text and icons.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Display’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Easy mode’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap the ‘Easy mode’ switch to turn it on.
Text and icons on the Home screen become bigger.
Check that the text and icons on the Home screen got bigger.
ko: 홈 화면의 글씨와 아이콘이 커졌는지 보세요.

lessons.title: Adjust brightness
lessons.desc: Adjust screen brightness from the quick settings panel.
steps: Swipe down from the top right of the screen.
The quick settings panel opens.
Drag the brightness bar to the right.
Drag it to the left to make the screen darker.
Swipe up to close the panel.

lessons.title: Change how long the screen stays on
lessons.desc: Change how long the screen stays on before it turns off, in Settings → Display → Screen timeout.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Display’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Screen timeout’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘5 minutes’.
Choose the time you want. Longer times use more battery.

lessons.title: Adjust ringtone volume and vibration
lessons.desc: Make the ringtone louder and have the phone vibrate while ringing.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Sounds and vibration’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Volume’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Drag the Ringtone bar to the right.
The further right, the louder the ringtone.
Tap the Back button at the bottom.
You go back to the previous screen.
Tap ‘Sound’.
To use vibration only, tap ‘Vibrate’.
Tap the ‘Vibrate while ringing’ switch to turn it on.
Sound and vibration both alert you.
ko: ‘전화벨이 울릴 때 진동도 울림’ 스위치를 눌러 켜세요.

lessons.title: Make a call with the keypad
lessons.desc: Make a phone call on a Galaxy phone by typing the number on the keypad.
steps: Tap the ‘Phone’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Keypad’ at the bottom.
Tap the digits of the phone number in order.
If you tap a wrong digit, delete it with the delete button at the bottom right.
Tap the green Call button.
When you finish talking, tap the red End call button.
ko: 통화를 마치면 빨간 통화 종료 버튼을 누르세요.

lessons.title: Answer or decline a call
lessons.desc: Answer a call by swiping the green button, decline with the red button, or decline with a text message.
steps: Touch and hold the green Answer button and swipe it up.
Swipe it out of the circle to connect the call.
To decline, touch and hold the red Decline button and swipe it up.
To decline with a text, swipe up ‘Send message’ at the bottom.
Choose a message and it is sent to the caller.
In Settings → Accessibility → Interaction and dexterity you can set calls to be answered with a single tap.
ko: 초록색 받기 버튼을 누른 채 위로 미세요.
받지 않으려면 빨간 거절 버튼을 누른 채 위로 미세요.
문자로 거절하려면 아래쪽 ‘메시지 보내기’를 위로 미세요.

lessons.title: Turn on the speaker during a call
lessons.desc: Turn on the speaker during a call so you can talk without holding the phone to your ear.
steps: Make or answer a call to start talking.
Tap ‘Speaker’.
You can hear and talk with the phone away from your ear.
To turn the speaker off, tap ‘Speaker’ again.
ko: 스피커를 끄려면 ‘스피커’를 한 번 더 누르세요.

lessons.title: Call back a missed call
lessons.desc: Call back a missed call from the Recents list in the Phone app.
steps: Tap the ‘Phone’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Recents’ at the bottom.
Swipe the missed number to the right.
Swiping right calls the number straight away.
If swiping does not call, tap the number and then tap the Call button.

lessons.title: Check your call history
lessons.desc: Check who called and when in the Recents list of the Phone app.
steps: Tap the ‘Phone’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Recents’ at the bottom.
Tap a name to see the details.
You can see when you talked.

lessons.title: Block spam numbers
lessons.desc: Block a spam phone number in the Phone app settings.
steps: Tap the ‘Phone’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the three dots (More options) at the top right.
Tap ‘Settings’.
Tap ‘Block numbers’.
Tap ‘Add phone number’.
The screen can look slightly different depending on the version.
Type the number you want to block.
Tap ‘Save’.
ko: 오른쪽 위 점 세 개(옵션 더보기)를 누르세요.

lessons.title: Save a new contact
lessons.desc: Save a new contact with a name and phone number in the Contacts app.
steps: Tap the ‘Contacts’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘+’ (Create contact) at the top right.
Tap the Name field.
Type the name.
Tap the Phone field.
Type the phone number.
Tap ‘Save’.

lessons.title: Search contacts by name
lessons.desc: Find a contact quickly by searching for their name.
steps: Tap the ‘Contacts’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the magnifying glass (Search) at the top.
Type the name you are looking for.
Tap the name that appears.

lessons.title: Edit a phone number
lessons.desc: Change the phone number saved for a contact.
steps: Tap the ‘Contacts’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the name of the person to change.
Tap ‘Edit’ at the bottom.
Tap the Phone field.
Delete the old number and type the new one.
Tap ‘Save’.

lessons.title: Add people you call often
lessons.desc: Set up speed dial so you can call someone by holding one number on the keypad.
steps: Tap the ‘Phone’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Keypad’ at the bottom.
Tap the three dots (More options) at the top right.
Tap ‘Speed dial numbers’.
Tap number ‘2’.
Choose any empty number.
Choose the person from your contacts.
Touch and hold ‘2’ on the keypad to call them.
Try holding ‘2’ on the practice screen.
ko: 오른쪽 위 점 세 개(옵션 더보기)를 누르세요.

lessons.title: Share a contact
lessons.desc: Send someone’s contact details to another person by text message.
steps: Tap the ‘Contacts’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the name of the person to share.
Tap ‘Share’ at the bottom.
Tap ‘Messages’.
Choose who will receive it.
Tap the Send button.

lessons.title: Send and reply to messages
lessons.desc: Send a text message and reply to one in the Messages app.
steps: Tap the ‘Messages’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the conversation you want to reply to.
To start a new message, tap the Start chat button at the bottom right.
Tap the message box at the bottom.
Type your message.
Tap the Send button on the right.

lessons.title: Type letters, numbers and symbols
lessons.desc: Type letters, numbers and symbols, and switch keyboard languages on the Samsung Keyboard.
steps: Type ‘Hello’ on the keyboard.
To type numbers or symbols, tap ‘!#1’.
To go back to letters, tap ‘ABC’ in the same place.
To type in another language, swipe the space bar left or right.
Only languages you added in the keyboard settings appear.
ko: 한글로 돌아가려면 같은 자리 버튼을 다시 누르세요.

lessons.title: Fix typing mistakes
lessons.desc: Fix typing mistakes with the delete key and by moving the cursor.
steps: Tap the delete key (⌫) once.
The letter just before the cursor is deleted.
Type the correct letter.
To fix a letter in the middle, tap that spot.
The cursor (the blinking line) moves to where you tapped.
ko: 가운데 글자를 고치려면 고칠 곳을 누르세요.

lessons.title: Copy and paste
lessons.desc: Copy text and paste it somewhere else.
steps: Touch and hold the text you want to copy.
Tap ‘Copy’.
Touch and hold the box where you want to paste.
Tap ‘Paste’.

lessons.title: Attach a photo to a message
lessons.desc: Attach a photo from Gallery to a text message.
steps: Tap the ‘Messages’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the conversation to send the photo to.
Tap ‘+’ to the left of the message box.
Tap ‘Gallery’.
Tap the photo to send.
Tap the Send button.

lessons.title: Translate text
lessons.desc: Translate a conversation in Messages with the Galaxy AI keyboard tool.
steps: Tap the ‘Messages’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the conversation to translate.
Tap the message box at the bottom.
Tap the Galaxy AI icon at the top left of the keyboard.
Tap ‘Chat translation’.
Choose the languages in the box at the top.
ko: 자판 왼쪽 위 어시스트(AI) 아이콘을 누르세요.

lessons.title: View and clear notifications
lessons.desc: Open the notification panel, read a notification and clear them all.
steps: Swipe down from the top left of the screen.
The notification panel opens.
Tap the notification you want to read.
Tapping a notification opens its app.
Swipe down from the top left of the screen.
The notification panel opens.
Tap ‘Clear’.
All notifications are removed.

lessons.title: Adjust app notifications
lessons.desc: Turn off notifications for apps you do not need to hear from.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Notifications’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘App notifications’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap the switch of an app to turn its notifications off.
Keep notifications on for important messaging apps.
ko: 알림을 끌 앱의 스위치를 눌러 끄세요.

lessons.title: Open the quick settings panel
lessons.desc: Open the quick settings panel and learn how its buttons work.
steps: Swipe down from the top right of the screen.
The quick settings panel opens. Swiping down from the top left opens notifications.
Look at the buttons on the panel.
Blue buttons are turned on. Tap a button to turn it on or off.
Touch and hold the ‘Wi-Fi’ button.
Holding a button opens its detailed settings.
Swipe up to close the panel.

lessons.title: Turn on the flashlight
lessons.desc: Turn the flashlight on and off from the quick settings panel.
steps: Swipe down from the top right of the screen.
The quick settings panel opens. Swiping down from the top left opens notifications.
Tap ‘Flashlight’.
The light on the back of the phone turns on.
To turn it off, tap ‘Flashlight’ again.

lessons.title: Control screen rotation
lessons.desc: Choose whether the screen turns when you turn the phone sideways.
steps: Swipe down from the top right of the screen.
The quick settings panel opens. Swiping down from the top left opens notifications.
Tap ‘Auto rotate’.
When it is on, the screen turns with the phone. When it is off, the screen stays upright.
Turn your phone sideways to try it.

lessons.title: Use Do not disturb and Airplane mode
lessons.desc: Silence calls and alerts with Do not disturb, and use Airplane mode on a plane.
steps: Swipe down from the top right of the screen.
The quick settings panel opens. Swiping down from the top left opens notifications.
Tap ‘Do not disturb’.
Calls and notifications will not make a sound. Tap again to turn it off.
Tap ‘Do not disturb’ again to turn it off.
Tap ‘Airplane mode’.
Calls and the internet are disconnected. Use it on a plane.
Tap it again to turn it off after your flight.
ko: ‘방해 금지’를 한 번 더 눌러 끄세요.

lessons.title: Connect to Wi-Fi
lessons.desc: Connect your Galaxy phone to a Wi-Fi network in Settings → Connections → Wi-Fi.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Connections’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Wi-Fi’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap the ‘Wi-Fi’ switch to turn it on.
A list of nearby Wi-Fi networks appears.
Tap the name of the Wi-Fi network to join.
A lock icon means it needs a password.
Type the Wi-Fi password.
It is often written on the back of the router.
Tap ‘Connect’.

lessons.title: Turn mobile data on and off
lessons.desc: Turn mobile data on or off in Settings → Connections → Data usage.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Connections’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Data usage’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap the ‘Mobile data’ switch to turn it on.
When it is off, the internet works only on Wi-Fi.

lessons.title: Check data usage
lessons.desc: See how much mobile data you used this month and which apps used the most.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Connections’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Data usage’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Mobile data usage’.
Check how much you used this month.
Apps that use the most are at the top. Your mobile carrier’s app shows how much is left.

lessons.title: Connect Bluetooth earphones
lessons.desc: Pair Bluetooth earphones with your Galaxy phone.
steps: Turn on your earphones in pairing mode.
Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Connections’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Bluetooth’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap the ‘Bluetooth’ switch to turn it on.
Tap the name of your earphones in the list.
Tap ‘Connect’.

lessons.title: Use mobile hotspot
lessons.desc: Share your phone’s internet connection with another device using Mobile Hotspot.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Connections’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Mobile Hotspot and Tethering’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Mobile Hotspot’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap the ‘Mobile Hotspot’ switch to turn it on.
This may cost extra. Check your mobile plan first.
On the other device, choose your phone’s name from its Wi-Fi list.
ko: 다른 기기의 와이파이 목록에서 내 휴대폰 이름을 고르세요.

lessons.title: Find location and NFC settings
lessons.desc: Find the Location and NFC switches in Settings.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Location’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap the ‘Location’ switch to turn it on.
Map and weather apps can then know where you are.
Tap the Back button at the bottom.
You go back to the previous screen.
Tap ‘Connections’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap the ‘NFC and contactless payments’ switch to turn it on.
Turn it on to pay or use transit cards with your phone.
ko: ‘NFC 및 비접촉 결제’ 스위치를 눌러 켜세요.

lessons.cat: Search the web and install apps
lessons.title: Search in Samsung Internet
lessons.desc: Search the web with the Samsung Internet browser on a Galaxy phone.
steps: Tap the ‘Samsung Internet’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Depending on the version, the app may be called ‘Samsung Internet’ or ‘Browser’.
Tap the address bar at the top.
Type what you want to find.
Tap the Go (↵) key at the bottom right of the keyboard.
Tap the search result you want to read.

lessons.cat: Search the web and install apps
lessons.title: Save pages you visit often
lessons.desc: Save web pages you visit often as bookmarks and open them later.
steps: Tap the ‘Samsung Internet’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the star (☆) to the right of the address bar.
The page you are viewing is saved to your bookmarks.
To open it later, tap the star (Bookmarks) at the bottom.
Tap the page you saved.
ko: 나중에 열 때는 아래쪽 별(북마크)을 누르세요.

lessons.cat: Search the web and install apps
lessons.title: Open a QR code
lessons.desc: Open a QR code with the Galaxy camera.
steps: Tap the ‘Camera’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Point the camera at the QR code.
In Photo mode, keep the code in the middle of the screen.
Tap the yellow link that appears on the screen.
Be careful with QR codes from places you do not know.
ko: 화면에 나온 노란 주소 표시를 누르세요.

lessons.cat: Search the web and install apps
lessons.title: Find downloaded files
lessons.desc: Find files you downloaded in the My Files app.
steps: Tap the ‘My Files’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Downloads’.
Tap the file to open.

lessons.cat: Search the web and install apps
lessons.title: Use Play Store and Galaxy Store
lessons.desc: Learn the difference between Google Play Store and Samsung Galaxy Store.
steps: Tap the ‘Play Store’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
This is Google’s app store, where you can find and download apps.
You need to sign in with a Google account.
Tap the Home button at the bottom center.
You go back to the first screen (the Home screen).
Tap the ‘Galaxy Store’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
This is Samsung’s app store, with many Samsung apps and themes.
ko: 구글의 앱 가게예요. 앱을 찾아 받을 수 있어요.
삼성의 앱 가게예요. 삼성 앱과 테마가 많아요.

lessons.cat: Search the web and install apps
lessons.title: Install, update and delete apps
lessons.desc: Install an app from Play Store, update apps in Galaxy Store and uninstall an app.
steps: Tap the ‘Play Store’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the search bar at the top.
Type the name of the app to install.
Tap ‘Install’ next to the app name.
Tap the ‘Galaxy Store’ app.
Now let us update apps.
Tap ‘Menu’ at the bottom.
Tap ‘Updates’.
Tap ‘Update all’.
On the Home screen, touch and hold the app you want to remove.
Tap ‘Uninstall’.
Tap ‘OK’.
You can install a removed app again from the store.
ko: 지울 앱을 홈 화면에서 길게 누르세요.

lessons.cat: Search the web and install apps
lessons.title: Find Google and carrier apps
lessons.desc: Find Google apps and your mobile carrier’s app with the search on the Apps screen.
steps: Swipe up on the Home screen to open the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Search’ at the top.
Type the name of the app.
Try Google, YouTube or the name of your mobile carrier.
Tap the app you found.
ko: 홈 화면을 위로 밀어 앱스 화면을 여세요.

lessons.title: Open the camera
lessons.desc: Open the Camera app and find the shutter button.
steps: Tap the ‘Camera’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Check that the camera screen appeared.
The white circle at the bottom center is the shutter button.

lessons.title: Focus the camera
lessons.desc: Tap the screen to focus the camera before taking a photo.
steps: Tap the ‘Camera’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the spot on the screen that you want to be sharp.
When a yellow circle appears, it is in focus.
Tap the white shutter button.
If photos look blurry, wipe the lens with a soft cloth.

lessons.title: Switch between front and rear cameras
lessons.desc: Switch between the rear camera and the front (selfie) camera.
steps: Tap the ‘Camera’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the circular arrows at the bottom right.
Swiping up or down on the screen also switches cameras.
Check that the front camera now shows your face.
ko: 앞 카메라로 바뀌어 내 얼굴이 보이는지 확인하세요.

lessons.title: Take a selfie
lessons.desc: Take a selfie with the front camera.
steps: Tap the ‘Camera’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the circular arrows at the bottom right.
Hold the phone so your face is in the middle of the screen.
Tap the white shutter button.
ko: 얼굴이 화면 가운데 오게 휴대폰을 드세요.

lessons.title: Zoom in when taking photos
lessons.desc: Zoom in on things far away when taking a photo.
steps: Tap the ‘Camera’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the number ‘3’ at the bottom.
Things far away look 3 times bigger. Tap ‘1x’ to go back.
The numbers differ by model (Ultra models zoom further).
Tap the white shutter button.

lessons.title: Use the camera timer
lessons.desc: Use the camera timer so the photo is taken a few seconds later.
steps: Tap the ‘Camera’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the Quick controls (⌄) icon at the top.
Tap the Timer icon.
Tap ‘5 seconds’.
Tap the white shutter button.
The photo is taken after the countdown.

lessons.title: Try Portrait and Night mode
lessons.desc: Try Portrait mode for blurred backgrounds and Night mode for dark places.
steps: Tap the ‘Camera’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Portrait’ at the bottom.
The person is sharp and the background is blurred.
Tap the white shutter button.
Tap ‘More’ at the bottom.
Tap ‘Night’.
Photos in dark places come out bright without the flash. Hold the phone still while it takes the photo.

lessons.title: Record a video
lessons.desc: Record a video with the Galaxy camera.
steps: Tap the ‘Camera’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Video’ at the bottom.
Tap the red Record button.
When you are done, tap the Stop button.
ko: 다 찍었으면 녹화 중지 버튼을 누르세요.

lessons.title: Take a screenshot or record the screen
lessons.desc: Take a screenshot with two buttons and record your screen from the quick settings panel.
steps: Briefly press the Side button and the Volume down button at the same time.
With a click sound, the screen is saved as a picture. You can see it in Gallery.
Swipe down from the top right of the screen.
The quick settings panel opens. Swiping down from the top left opens notifications.
Tap ‘Screen recorder’.
If you cannot see it, swipe down on the panel once more.
Tap ‘Start recording’.
To stop recording, tap the Stop icon at the top of the screen.
ko: 측면 버튼과 음량(하) 버튼을 동시에 짧게 누르세요.
녹화를 끝내려면 화면 위쪽 중지 아이콘을 누르세요.

lessons.title: Find the photo you just took
lessons.desc: Find the photo you just took in Gallery.
steps: Tap the ‘Gallery’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the first photo (top left).
Your newest photo is always first.
Swipe left to see the next photo.

lessons.title: Create an album
lessons.desc: Create a new album in Gallery to keep photos together.
steps: Tap the ‘Gallery’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Albums’ at the bottom.
Tap ‘+’ (Add) at the top.
Tap ‘Album’.
Type a name for the album.
Tap ‘Create’.
Then choose the photos to put in it.

lessons.title: Crop and brighten a photo
lessons.desc: Crop a photo and make it brighter in Gallery.
steps: Tap the ‘Gallery’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the photo to edit.
Tap the pencil icon (Edit) at the bottom.
Drag a corner of the photo inward to crop it.
Tap ‘Tone’ at the bottom.
Drag the brightness bar to the right.
Tap ‘Save’.

lessons.title: Copy text from a photo
lessons.desc: Copy text from a photo in Gallery and paste it into a message or note.
steps: Tap the ‘Gallery’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap a photo that has text in it.
Tap the yellow ‘T’ icon.
It appears only when there is text in the photo.
Touch and hold the text you want to copy.
Tap ‘Copy’.
You can paste it into a message or a note.

lessons.title: Share several photos
lessons.desc: Select several photos in Gallery and share them at once.
steps: Tap the ‘Gallery’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Touch and hold one photo you want to send.
Tap more photos to send with it.
A check in the circle means the photo is selected.
Tap ‘Share’ at the bottom.
Tap the app to send with (for example, Messages).
Choose who to send to and send.

lessons.title: Restore deleted photos
lessons.desc: Get back photos you deleted from the Gallery Recycle bin.
steps: Tap the ‘Gallery’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Menu’ at the bottom.
Tap ‘Recycle bin’.
Tap the photo to bring back.
Deleted photos stay in the Recycle bin for a while.
Tap ‘Restore’.

lessons.title: Find documents in My Files
lessons.desc: Find documents saved on your phone in the My Files app.
steps: Tap the ‘My Files’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Documents’.
Tap the document to open.

lessons.title: Send files with Quick Share
lessons.desc: Send a photo to a nearby phone with Quick Share.
steps: Tap the ‘Gallery’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the photo to send.
Tap ‘Share’ at the bottom.
Tap ‘Quick Share’.
The other phone needs Quick Share turned on too (Settings → Connected devices → Quick Share).
Tap the name of the phone to send to.
On the receiving phone, tap ‘Accept’.

lessons.title: Put an app on the Home screen
lessons.desc: Put an app from the Apps screen on your Home screen.
steps: Swipe up on the Home screen to open the Apps screen.
Touch and hold the app you want on the Home screen.
Tap ‘Add to Home’.
ko: 홈 화면을 위로 밀어 앱스 화면을 여세요.
홈 화면에 놓을 앱을 길게 누르세요.

lessons.title: Make folders and widgets
lessons.desc: Group apps into a folder and add a weather widget to the Home screen.
steps: Touch and hold an app on the Home screen and drag it onto another app.
A folder with both apps is created.
Tap the folder name and type a name.
Touch and hold an empty spot on the Home screen.
Tap ‘Widgets’.
Tap ‘Weather’.
Tap ‘Add’.
ko: 홈 화면의 앱 하나를 길게 누른 채 다른 앱 위에 끌어 놓으세요.
홈 화면의 빈 곳을 길게 누르세요.

lessons.title: Change wallpaper, theme and lock screen
lessons.desc: Use one of your photos as the wallpaper for the lock screen or Home screen.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Wallpaper and style’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Change wallpapers’.
To use your own photo, tap ‘Gallery’.
Tap the photo to use.
Choose the lock screen, the Home screen or both.
Tap ‘Done’.
ko: 잠금화면과 홈 화면 중 어디에 쓸지 고르세요.

lessons.title: Set an alarm and a timer
lessons.desc: Set an alarm and start a timer in the Clock app.
steps: Tap the ‘Clock’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Alarm’ at the bottom.
Tap ‘+’ at the bottom right.
Swipe the numbers up or down to set the time.
Tap ‘Save’.
To use a timer, tap ‘Timer’ at the bottom.
Set the time and tap ‘Start’.

lessons.title: Add an appointment to the calendar
lessons.desc: Add an appointment to the Calendar app.
steps: Tap the ‘Calendar’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘+’ (Add event) at the bottom right.
Tap the Title field.
Type the name of the appointment.
Tap ‘Start’ to choose the date and time.
Tap ‘Save’.

lessons.title: Get reminders for things to do
lessons.desc: Get a reminder for something you need to do by adding an alert to a calendar event.
steps: Tap the ‘Calendar’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘+’ (Add event) at the bottom right.
Type the thing to do as the title.
Tap ‘Reminder’.
Tap when you want the reminder (for example, 10 minutes before).
Tap ‘Save’.
The reminder arrives at the time you chose.

lessons.title: Use Samsung Notes
lessons.desc: Write a quick note in Samsung Notes.
steps: Tap the ‘Samsung Notes’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘+’ at the bottom right.
Write what you want to note.
When you finish, tap the Back button.
The note is saved automatically.

lessons.title: Record your voice
lessons.desc: Record your voice with the Voice Recorder app.
steps: Tap the ‘Voice Recorder’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the Record button.
Speak into the phone.
Tap ‘Stop’.
The recording is saved in the list.

lessons.title: Use weather, calculator and radio
lessons.desc: Check the weather, use the calculator and listen to the radio.
steps: Tap the ‘Weather’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Look at today’s weather and temperature.
Location must be on to see the weather where you are.
Tap the Home button at the bottom center.
You go back to the first screen (the Home screen).
Tap the ‘Calculator’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap numbers, + and = to calculate.
Tap the ‘Radio’ app.
The radio needs wired earphones, which work as the antenna.
Some models and carriers do not have a Radio app.

lessons.title: Email photos with Gmail
lessons.desc: Send photos to family by email with the Gmail app on a Galaxy phone.
steps: Tap the ‘Gmail’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Compose’ at the bottom right.
Type the email address of the person in the ‘To’ box.
Tap the paper clip (Attach) at the top.
Tap the photo you want to send.
You can tap more than one photo.
Type a short subject.
Tap the Send button (paper plane) at the top.

lessons.title: Send a video to family
lessons.desc: Send a video from Gallery to a family member with the Messages app.
steps: Tap the ‘Gallery’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the video you want to send.
Tap ‘Share’ at the bottom.
Tap ‘Messages’.
Choose the person to send it to.
Tap the Send button.
Long videos may be too big for a text message. Then use Quick Share or email instead.

lessons.title: Make a video call with Google Meet
lessons.desc: Make a video call to family with the Google Meet app.
steps: Tap the ‘Meet’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘New’.
Tap the name of the person to call.
They also need the Google Meet app or a Google account.
Tap the video call button.
When you finish, tap the red End call button.
ko: 통화를 마치면 빨간 통화 종료 버튼을 누르세요.

lessons.title: Open Samsung Wallet
lessons.desc: Open Samsung Wallet and look around the cards and menus.
steps: Tap the ‘Samsung Wallet’ app.
You can also open it by swiping up the card image at the bottom of the screen.
Look at your saved cards and the menus.
If this is your first time, there are no cards yet. The next lesson shows the add card screen.

lessons.title: Look at the add card screen
lessons.desc: Look at the screen for adding a payment card to Samsung Wallet.
steps: Tap the ‘Samsung Wallet’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
This lesson changes real settings or has real results. Read all the steps first, then do them on your phone.
Tap ‘+’ (Add) at the top.
Look at what you can add.
You can add payment cards, transit cards and more, depending on your country.
Tap ‘Payment card’.
Read the instructions for adding a card.

lessons.title: Choose a card to pay with
lessons.desc: Choose a card in Samsung Wallet and pay by holding your phone near the card reader.
steps: Tap the ‘Samsung Wallet’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
This lesson changes real settings or has real results. Read all the steps first, then do them on your phone.
Tap the card you want to pay with.
Use your fingerprint or enter your payment PIN.
Hold the back of your phone close to the card reader.
ko: 휴대폰 뒷면을 카드 단말기에 가까이 대세요.

lessons.title: Create a PIN
lessons.desc: Protect your phone with a PIN screen lock.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
This lesson changes real settings or has real results. Read all the steps first, then do them on your phone.
Tap ‘Lock screen and AOD’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Screen lock and biometrics’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Screen lock type’.
Tap ‘PIN’.
Type at least 4 digits that are easy for you to remember.
Avoid numbers others can guess, like your birthday or phone number.
Type the same digits again to confirm.
ko: 같은 숫자를 한 번 더 적어 확인하세요.

lessons.title: Register fingerprints and face
lessons.desc: Register your fingerprint, and your face if you like, to unlock your phone.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
This lesson changes real settings or has real results. Read all the steps first, then do them on your phone.
Tap ‘Security and privacy’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Screen lock and biometrics’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Fingerprints’.
Enter your PIN.
If you do not have a PIN, create one first.
Touch and lift your finger on the fingerprint mark at the bottom of the screen, again and again.
Use a finger you use often and move it a little each time.
To add your face too, tap ‘Face recognition’ on the same screen.
ko: 화면 아래쪽 지문 표시에 손가락을 댔다 떼기를 반복하세요.
얼굴도 등록하려면 같은 화면에서 ‘얼굴 인식’을 누르세요.

lessons.title: Check app permissions and location sharing
lessons.desc: See which apps used your location, camera or microphone and turn off access you do not need.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Security and privacy’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Permissions used in last 24 hours’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
See which apps used your location, camera or microphone.
Tap ‘Location’.
If there is an app you do not know, change it to ‘Don’t allow’.
ko: 모르는 앱이 있으면 ‘허용 안 함’으로 바꾸세요.

lessons.title: Learn about Secure Folder and Samsung Pass
lessons.desc: Find Secure Folder and Samsung Pass in Settings.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Security and privacy’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘More security settings’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Secure Folder’.
Read the information about Secure Folder.
Tap the Back button at the bottom.
You go back to the previous screen.
Tap ‘Passwords, passkeys and autofill’.
Samsung Pass is in here. It helps you sign in with your fingerprint.

lessons.title: Add medical info and emergency contacts
lessons.desc: Add medical information and emergency contacts that can help in an emergency.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Safety and emergency’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Medical info’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Enter your name, blood type, medicines and allergies.
Tap the Back button at the bottom.
You go back to the previous screen.
Tap ‘Emergency contacts’.
Add your family members as contacts.

lessons.title: Check Emergency SOS settings
lessons.desc: Check how Emergency SOS works on your phone without making a call.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Actually pressing the buttons calls emergency services. In this lesson, only look at the screen.
Tap ‘Safety and emergency’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Emergency SOS’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Read how many times to press the Side button to make the call.
Pressing the Side button the number of times shown calls the number you set.
ko: 측면 버튼을 몇 번 누르면 전화가 걸리는지 읽어 보세요.

lessons.title: Find your phone with Samsung Find
lessons.desc: Turn on the setting that lets you find your phone with Samsung Find if you lose it.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Security and privacy’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Lost device protection’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Find My Mobile’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap the ‘Allow this phone to be found’ switch to turn it on.
You must be signed in to your Samsung account.
If you lose your phone, go to smartthingsfind.samsung.com on another device.
ko: ‘이 폰을 찾을 수 있도록 허용’ 스위치를 눌러 켜세요.
잃어버리면 다른 기기에서 smartthingsfind.samsung.com 에 들어가세요.

lessons.title: Set up your phone for the first time
lessons.desc: Set up a new Galaxy phone for the first time.
steps: Press and hold the Side button to turn the phone on.
Check your language and tap ‘Start’.
Choose a Wi-Fi network and connect.
For the rest, follow the instructions on the screen and tap ‘Next’.
ko: 측면 버튼을 길게 눌러 전원을 켜세요.

lessons.title: Learn about SIM and eSIM
lessons.desc: Learn what a SIM card and an eSIM are, and check your phone number in SIM manager.
steps: A SIM (Nano-SIM) is a small card from your mobile carrier.
An eSIM is a SIM you download to the phone, with no card.
Support for eSIM and two numbers depends on your model and carrier.
Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Connections’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘SIM manager’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Check that your number and carrier appear.
ko: eSIM은 카드 없이 휴대폰에 내려받는 유심이에요.

lessons.title: Check Samsung and Google accounts
lessons.desc: Check that your phone is signed in to a Samsung account and a Google account.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Accounts and backup’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Manage accounts’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Check that there is a Samsung account and a Google account.
You need them for backups, installing apps and finding your phone. Write down your ID and password.
ko: Samsung 계정과 Google 계정이 있는지 보세요.

lessons.title: Move contacts and photos with Smart Switch
lessons.desc: Move contacts, photos and more to a new Galaxy phone with Smart Switch.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Accounts and backup’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Bring data from old device’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
On the new phone, choose ‘Receive data’.
Keep the two phones close together and follow the instructions on the screen.
ko: 두 휴대폰을 가까이 두고 화면 안내를 따르세요.

lessons.title: Check backup status
lessons.desc: Check when your phone was last backed up to Samsung Cloud.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Accounts and backup’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Samsung Cloud’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Check the date of the last backup.

lessons.title: Restore from a backup
lessons.desc: Restore your data from a Samsung Cloud backup.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Accounts and backup’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Samsung Cloud’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Restore data’.
Choose the device and the items to restore.
Tap ‘Restore’.

lessons.title: Magnify part of the screen
lessons.desc: Turn on the magnification shortcut and zoom in on part of the screen with a triple tap.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Accessibility’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Vision enhancements’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Magnification’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Magnification shortcut’.
Tap the ‘Magnification shortcut’ switch to turn it on.
Tap ‘Triple tap screen’.
Quickly tap three times where you want to zoom in.
ko: 확대할 곳을 빠르게 세 번 누르세요.

lessons.title: Increase text contrast
lessons.desc: Turn on high contrast fonts so text stands out from the background.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Accessibility’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Vision enhancements’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap the ‘High contrast fonts’ switch to turn it on.
Letters get a darker outline and stand out from the background.

lessons.title: Have the screen read aloud with TalkBack
lessons.desc: Turn on TalkBack to have the screen read aloud, after learning how to turn it off.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
With TalkBack on, the way you tap changes. Read how to turn it off first.
Tap ‘Accessibility’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘TalkBack’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Read how to turn it off first.
Tap the ‘TalkBack’ switch to turn it on.
With it on, one tap reads an item aloud and a double tap opens it.

lessons.title: Adjust sound and captions
lessons.desc: Turn on Live Caption for videos and Mono audio for one-ear listening.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Accessibility’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Hearing enhancements’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Live Caption’.
Tap the ‘Use Live Caption’ switch to turn it on.
Speech in videos is shown as text.
Tap the Back button at the bottom.
You go back to the previous screen.
Tap the ‘Mono audio’ switch to turn it on.
You hear both sides of the sound even with one ear.

lessons.title: Check hearing aid support
lessons.desc: Turn on hearing aid compatibility for clearer calls with a hearing aid.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Accessibility’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Hearing enhancements’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Hearing aid support’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap the ‘Hearing aid compatibility’ switch to turn it on.
Calls sound clearer when you use a hearing aid.
Connect Bluetooth hearing aids in the Bluetooth menu.

lessons.title: Adjust touch settings and the accessibility shortcut
lessons.desc: Make touches easier: answer calls with one tap, change the touch and hold delay and set an accessibility shortcut.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Accessibility’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Interaction and dexterity’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap the ‘Single tap mode’ switch to turn it on.
You can answer calls with one tap instead of swiping.
Tap ‘Touch and hold delay’.
If touch and hold is hard, make the time longer.
Choose the time you want.
Tap the Back button twice.
Tap ‘Accessibility shortcut’.
You can turn on an accessibility feature you use often with one button.
ko: ‘살짝 밀기를 한 번 누르기로 대체하기’ 스위치를 눌러 켜세요.

lessons.title: Find apps that use a lot of battery
lessons.desc: Find out which apps use the most battery.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Battery’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Daily usage’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Look at the apps that used the most battery.
If an app you rarely use uses a lot, close or remove it.

lessons.title: Turn on Power saving
lessons.desc: Turn on Power saving to make the battery last longer.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Battery’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap the ‘Power saving’ switch to turn it on.
The battery lasts longer. Some app notifications may arrive later.
You can also turn it on with the ‘Power saving’ button in the quick settings panel.

lessons.title: Check storage
lessons.desc: Check how much storage space is left on your phone.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Device care’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Storage’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Check how much space is left.
Emptying the recycle bin and removing duplicate files frees up space.

lessons.title: Clean up large files
lessons.desc: Find and delete large files you no longer need in My Files.
steps: Tap the ‘My Files’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Manage storage’.
Tap ‘Large files’.
Select only the files you do not need and tap ‘Delete’.

lessons.title: Check your phone with Device care
lessons.desc: Check and tidy up your phone with Device care.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Device care’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Optimize now’.
It closes apps you are not using and checks your phone.

lessons.title: Update the software
lessons.desc: Check for and install software updates on your Galaxy phone.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Software update’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Download and install’.
If there is a new version, it downloads and installs. Do this on Wi-Fi while charging.

lessons.title: Check your model and One UI version
lessons.desc: Find your phone’s model name and its One UI version in Settings → About phone.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘About phone’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Check the model name at the top.
Tap ‘Software information’.
Check the ‘One UI version’.
Tell the service center this along with your model name.

lessons.title: Ask Bixby with your voice
lessons.desc: Set the Side button to wake Bixby and ask it to do things with your voice.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Advanced features’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Side button’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Wake Bixby’.
Pressing and holding the Side button will now start Bixby.
Press and hold the Side button and say what you want.
For example: “Set an alarm for 7 tomorrow morning.”
Let go of the button when you finish speaking.
ko: 측면 버튼을 누른 채 원하는 것을 말하세요.

lessons.title: Search for things on your screen
lessons.desc: Search for something on your screen by circling it with Circle to Search.
steps: Touch and hold the Home button at the bottom of the screen.
Draw a circle around the thing you want to know about.
Read the search results at the bottom.
Bixby Vision is available on the Galaxy S25, S24 and S23 series. The S26 uses this method (Circle to Search).
ko: 화면 아래 홈 버튼을 길게 누르세요.
궁금한 물건 둘레에 손가락으로 동그라미를 그리세요.
아래쪽에 나온 검색 결과를 읽어 보세요.

lessons.title: Learn about call translation and Interpreter
lessons.desc: Turn on Live translate in the Phone app and use it during a call.
steps: Tap the ‘Phone’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the three dots at the top right.
Tap ‘Settings’.
Tap ‘Live translate’.
Tap the ‘Live translate’ switch to turn it on.
During a call, tap ‘Call assist’.
Tap ‘Live translate’.
ko: 오른쪽 위 점 세 개를 누르세요.

lessons.title: Polish and summarize text
lessons.desc: Fix spelling and grammar in a message with the Galaxy AI keyboard tool.
steps: Tap the ‘Messages’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap a conversation.
Type your message.
Tap the Galaxy AI icon at the top left of the keyboard.
Tap ‘Spelling and grammar’.
It fixes mistakes. ‘Summarize’ makes long text shorter.
ko: 자판 왼쪽 위 어시스트(AI) 아이콘을 누르세요.

lessons.title: Turn recordings into text
lessons.desc: Turn a voice recording into text with Galaxy AI in Voice Recorder.
steps: Tap the ‘Voice Recorder’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the recording to turn into text.
Tap the Galaxy AI icon.
Tap ‘Transcribe’.
Read the text it made.

lessons.title: Edit photos with AI
lessons.desc: Remove a person or object from a photo with Galaxy AI in Gallery.
steps: Tap the ‘Gallery’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap the photo to edit.
Tap the Galaxy AI icon.
Tap ‘Object eraser’.
Trace around the person or thing to remove with your finger.
Tap ‘Erase’.
If you like the result, tap ‘Save’.
ko: 지울 사람이나 물건 둘레를 손가락으로 따라 그리세요.

lessons.title: Check features by model
lessons.desc: See which Galaxy AI features your phone supports in Settings.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Galaxy AI’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Look at the list of AI features your phone can use.
Features not in the list are not supported on this model.
Some features depend on model and carrier, or need an internet connection.
ko: 목록에서 내 휴대폰이 쓸 수 있는 AI 기능을 보세요.

lessons.cat: Connect to TV, PC and watch
lessons.title: Show your screen on a TV with Smart View
lessons.desc: Show your phone screen on a TV with Smart View.
steps: Swipe down from the top right of the screen.
The quick settings panel opens. Swiping down from the top left opens notifications.
Tap ‘Smart View’.
Tap the name of the TV to connect to.
It works best when the TV and phone are on the same Wi-Fi.
Tap ‘Start now’.

lessons.cat: Connect to TV, PC and watch
lessons.title: Connect to a PC
lessons.desc: Connect your Galaxy phone to a Windows PC with Link to Windows.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Connected devices’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Link to Windows’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Read the instructions on the screen.
On the computer, open the address shown to finish connecting.
ko: 컴퓨터에서 안내된 주소를 열어 연결을 마치세요.

lessons.cat: Connect to TV, PC and watch
lessons.title: Learn about Samsung DeX
lessons.desc: Find out what Samsung DeX is and where its settings are.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Connected devices’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Samsung DeX’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Read the information.

lessons.cat: Connect to TV, PC and watch
lessons.title: Connect a watch and earbuds
lessons.desc: Connect a Galaxy watch or earbuds with the Galaxy Wearable app.
steps: Tap the ‘Galaxy Wearable’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Start’.
Follow the instructions on the screen to finish connecting.

lessons.cat: Connect to TV, PC and watch
lessons.title: Connect appliances with SmartThings
lessons.desc: Connect home appliances to your phone with SmartThings.
steps: Tap the ‘SmartThings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘+’ (Add) at the top.
Choose the appliance to connect.
Follow the instructions on the screen to finish connecting.

lessons.cat: Connect to TV, PC and watch
lessons.title: Learn about Music Share
lessons.desc: Turn on Music Share so friends can play music through your Bluetooth speaker.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Connected devices’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Music Share’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap the ‘Music Share’ switch to turn it on.
Friends can play music from their phones on your Bluetooth speaker.

lessons.title: Use two apps with split screen
lessons.desc: Use two apps at the same time with split screen view.
steps: Tap the Recents button at the bottom left.
Tap the small icon at the top of an app.
Tap ‘Open in split screen view’.
Choose the second app for the bottom half.
ko: 아래쪽 왼쪽 최근 앱 버튼을 누르세요.
앱 화면 위쪽의 작은 아이콘을 누르세요.

lessons.title: Set up Modes and Routines
lessons.desc: Turn on Sleep mode in Modes and Routines.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Modes and Routines’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Modes’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Sleep’.
Tap ‘Turn on’.
Notifications go quiet and the screen gets darker while you sleep.

lessons.title: Show a clock on the lock screen
lessons.desc: Show a clock on the screen even when it is off, with Always On Display.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Lock screen and AOD’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap the ‘Always On Display’ switch to turn it on.
You can see the clock even when the screen is off. It uses a little more battery.
To change the clock style, touch and hold the lock screen.
ko: 시계 모양을 바꾸려면 잠금화면을 길게 누르세요.

lessons.title: See screen time with Digital Wellbeing
lessons.desc: See how long you used your phone today and set app timers.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Digital Wellbeing’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Look at how long you used your phone today.
Tap ‘App timers’.
You can set a daily time limit for each app.

lessons.title: Learn about Samsung Health, Kids and Game Booster
lessons.desc: Take a look at Samsung Health, Samsung Kids and Game Booster.
steps: Tap the ‘Samsung Health’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, find it on the Apps screen.
Look at your step count and exercise records.
Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Apps’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Samsung Kids’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Open’.
You can choose the apps and time limits for your grandchildren.
While playing a game, tap the Game Booster icon at the bottom of the screen.
ko: 게임 중에는 화면 아래 게임 부스터 아이콘을 눌러요.

lessons.title: Find Samsung News, Samsung.com and Global Goals
lessons.desc: Find the Samsung.com and Samsung Global Goals apps, and Samsung News.
steps: Tap the ‘Samsung.com’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Here you can read Samsung product news and get support.
Tap the Home button at the bottom center.
You go back to the first screen (the Home screen).
Tap the ‘Samsung Global Goals’ app.
Find ‘Samsung Global Goals’ on the Apps screen.
Look for Samsung News with the search on the Apps screen.
ko: 삼성 제품 소식과 고객지원을 볼 수 있어요.
삼성 뉴스는 앱스 화면 검색에서 찾아보세요.

lessons.title: Use the S Pen on supported models
lessons.desc: Take out the S Pen, open its menu and try the PENUP app on supported Ultra models.
steps: Gently press the end of the S Pen at the bottom of the phone.
Tap the feature you want in the menu on the screen.
Tap the ‘PENUP’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
When you finish, push the S Pen back in until it clicks.
ko: 휴대폰 아래쪽 S펜 끝을 살짝 누르세요.
화면에 나온 메뉴에서 쓸 기능을 누르세요.
다 쓰면 S펜을 딸깍 소리가 날 때까지 밀어 넣으세요.

lessons.title: When the ringtone does not sound
lessons.desc: What to check when your phone does not ring.
steps: Swipe down from the top right of the screen.
The quick settings panel opens. Swiping down from the top left opens notifications.
Tap the ‘Sound’ button.
If it is set to Mute or Vibrate, tap it to change it to Sound.
If ‘Do not disturb’ is blue (on), tap it to turn it off.
Press the Volume up button on the side to make it louder.
ko: ‘방해 금지’가 파랗게 켜져 있으면 눌러 끄세요.
옆면 음량(상) 버튼을 눌러 소리를 키우세요.

lessons.title: When calls or the internet do not work
lessons.desc: What to check when calls or the internet stop working.
steps: Swipe down from the top right of the screen.
The quick settings panel opens. Swiping down from the top left opens notifications.
If ‘Airplane mode’ is on, tap it to turn it off.
If ‘Mobile data’ is off, tap it to turn it on.
If the signal is weak, try moving to another place.
If it still does not work, restart your phone.
ko: ‘비행기 탑승 모드’가 켜져 있으면 눌러 끄세요.
신호가 약하면 다른 장소로 옮겨 보세요.
그래도 안 되면 휴대폰을 다시 시작하세요.

lessons.title: When your phone does not charge
lessons.desc: What to check when your Galaxy phone will not charge.
steps: Check that the cable and charger are plugged in all the way.
If the port is wet, let it dry completely before charging.
Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Battery’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Tap ‘Charging settings’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
If it still does not charge, take the phone, charger and cable to a service center.
ko: 연결잭이 젖었으면 완전히 말린 뒤 충전하세요.
그래도 안 되면 충전기와 선을 가지고 서비스센터에 가세요.

lessons.title: When your phone gets hot
lessons.desc: What to do when your phone gets hot.
steps: If it is charging, unplug the charger.
Tap the Recents button.
Tap ‘Close all’ to close the apps.
Stop using the phone for a while and let it cool in a cool place.
ko: 잠시 쓰지 말고 서늘한 곳에서 식히세요.

lessons.title: When the screen freezes
lessons.desc: Force a frozen Galaxy phone to restart with two buttons.
steps: Press and hold the Side button and the Volume down button together for more than 7 seconds.
Keep holding until the screen turns off.
When the screen turns off, let go and wait.
ko: 측면 버튼과 음량(하) 버튼을 함께 7초 이상 누르세요.

lessons.title: What to check when your phone gets wet
lessons.desc: What to check and do when your phone gets wet.
steps: Wipe the phone with a soft cloth and dry it completely.
Do not plug in the charger until it is completely dry.
If it was sea water, pool water or soapy water, rinse it with clean water and then dry it.
If anything seems wrong, go to a service center right away.
ko: 완전히 마를 때까지 충전기를 꽂지 마세요.
바닷물·수영장 물·비눗물이면 깨끗한 물로 헹군 뒤 말리세요.

lessons.title: Run diagnostics in Samsung Members
lessons.desc: Check your phone for problems with Phone diagnostics in Samsung Members.
steps: Tap the ‘Samsung Members’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘Support’.
Tap ‘Phone diagnostics’.
Tap ‘Test all’ or the item you want to check.

lessons.title: Check model and symptoms before contacting service
lessons.desc: Write down your model name and the problem before contacting Samsung service.
steps: Tap the ‘Settings’ app.
If it is not on the Home screen, swipe up to find it on the Apps screen.
Tap ‘About phone’.
If you cannot see it, swipe up to find it.
Write down the model number (for example, SM-S942N).
Write down when and how the problem happens.
Contact Samsung support for your country or book a service center visit.
Find your country’s support page at samsung.com/support.
ko: 언제, 어떻게 문제가 생기는지 적어 두세요.
